[Graffin] Wow, so many useful, yet tacky gadgets at Kmart I never knew existed.

https://www.kmart.com.au/product/microwave-cleaner-and-fridg… (you gotta laugh at this)
[WatchNerd] If you can't tell whether your dishes are clean or dirty you've got problems.
[Graffin] I think it needs to be expanded to show the level of fullness or emptiness of the dishwasher to save you from having to open it and looking!
[dtc] We have of those at work, stops people just shoving dirty dishes in without paying attention.
[corky] And what isnt landfill in this world? Or back to caveman days?
[Froot Loops] Fridge Deodoriser is great. Just fill it with bicarb and change it every few months for a neutral smelling fridge.
[PVA] It used to. There was a brand of sauce just like this.
[Graffin] What if you don't like the bottle it comes in, or buy it in bulk and need a smaller bottle, or collected a whole heap of sauces from KFC and want to consolidate them into a single bottle?
(I agree, most of this stuff is useless)
[ne-us] https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0FS131VM7?ref=cm_sw_r_cso_cp_a…
[dufflover] Peeler with Catcher(kmart.com.au). 66% off RRP$1.50.
Saw this at Target in-store for only 10c, and it's not even worth that imo.
Gave it a couple of goes and it's useless. It's actual peeler part is fixed, doesn't swivel, and quickly ends up clogged up instead of all the peels cleanly ending up in the catcher. The most useless thing ever and that's including all the things I've bought from AliExpress over the years.
[His_Holiness] So much plastic crap which will end up in landfill after a few uses
[demmogorgon] Genuine question - what will happen to them if nobody buys them?
[shxhshzhz] They're 50 cent items that could be useful to others. If you don't like it don't buy it. What else do you expect for 50 cents? Negging the post was unnecessary
[Clear] Must be a quiet night at Whingepool and it's leaking again.
